newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaraguan president refuses to bow to students.
newsitem.headline: Nicaraguan president refuses to bow to students.

text.p: Nicaraguan President Arnoldo Aleman on Tuesday turned down student demands for an increase in funding for universities after clashes between students and authorities.
"The government cannot offer what it cannot fulfil and is not ready to negotiate," Aleman told reporters.
Protests against government refusal to increase funding have flared since last Thursday, and at least 23 people have been injured in clashes, the Red Cross said.
Aleman said the government was ready to listen to the students but warned that it could take more drastic measures against them if they did not give up their protests.
